title: Undergraduate Complexity Research
field: Complex systems (physical, natural and social sciences, mathematics)
about: SFI's Undergraduate Complexity Research program is a full-time, ten-week, in-person research experience from 30 May to 7 August 2027 for undergraduates in the sciences and mathematics. Applications are due 13 January by 4 PM MST.
requirements: Undergraduate students from all backgrounds in the physical, natural and social sciences and mathematics
Strong quantitative skills or programming experience favourably considered
Full-time, ten-week, in-person commitment, 30 May to 7 August 2027

upskill.name: Statistical & Mathematical Foundations I
why: "Strong quantitative skills or programming experience favourably considered" → "Build a practical foundation in descriptive statistics by summarizing datasets, examining distributions, and interpreting measures of central tendency."

"Undergraduate students from all backgrounds in the physical, natural and social sciences and mathematics" → "Apply inferential statistical methods, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and analysis of variance (ANOVA), to draw conclusions from samples."
